issue.description:
ADR-003 records that the sharded writer already uses content-hash object names, but `cmd_sync_flush_only` hardcodes `CheckpointMode::Monolithic`, so the deduplicating path is unreachable dead code and per-mutation publication stays O(workspace size) on every mutation. Distinct from beadrs-8daa18dc (content-address the monolithic root) and beadrs-a5f95091 (apply pointer-declared tombstones), which fix monolith defects but leave monolithic mode the only mode. Scope: an explicit, documented way to select sharded mode (config key or flag), dedup and tombstone behavior tests in sharded mode, and compatibility/migration expectations for workspaces that switch modes.
